user.title: Thermal Balance — Step 1: Room Geometry & Insulation
user.description: Configure room dimensions, window glazing, orientation, and building insulation.

data_description.room_area: Total usable floor area of the room in square meters (m²).
data_description.ceiling_height: Vertical height from floor to ceiling in meters.
data_description.window_area: Total area of all outdoor-facing window glass in square meters (m²).
data_description.external_walls_fraction: Proportion of room perimeter facing outside (0.25 = 1 wall, 0.50 = corner room, 1.00 = detached building).
data_description.window_azimuth: Compass direction the primary windows face (0°=North, 90°=East, 180°=South, 270°=West).
data_description.u_wall: Wall heat transfer coefficient (lower means better insulation, e.g. 0.20-0.35 W/m²·K).
data_description.u_window: Window glazing heat transfer coefficient (e.g. 1.1 W/m²·K for double-glazed low-e windows).
data_description.use_empirical_hlc: Enable dynamic learning of real-world room heat loss coefficient based on live thermal response.

equipment.title: Thermal Balance — Step 2: Equipment, Shading & Tariffs
equipment.description: Configure AC / heat pump specifications, window shading type, and electricity pricing.

data_description.hvac_mode: Primary operational mode: Cooling (summer), Heating (winter heat pump), or Auto (follows thermostat/temperature delta).
data_description.ac_max_cooling: Maximum thermal cooling/heating capacity of the AC unit in Watts (from manufacturer datasheet, e.g. 3350 W).
data_description.ac_airflow: Volumetric airflow rate of the indoor AC blower in m³/h (e.g. 370 m³/h).
data_description.curtain_type: Installed window covering type (Blackout curtains block ~93% solar heat gain, Roller blinds ~74%).
data_description.electricity_rate: Price per kWh of electrical energy to calculate running costs and shading financial savings.
data_description.currency_symbol: Currency symbol to display on cost and savings sensors (e.g. $, €, ₴, £).
data_description.illuminance_threshold: Indoor illuminance level below which curtains are considered closed during daylight hours (default 150 lx).

sensors.title: Thermal Balance — Step 3: Sensors & Meteorological Inputs
sensors.description: Map physical room temperature sensors and optional environmental entities.

data.sensor_solar: Solar Irradiance Sensor (W/m², Optional — Auto-Calculated if empty)
data.sensor_weather: Weather Entity (weather.*, Optional — for Cloud Cover)
data.sensor_t_ac_exit: AC Louver Outlet Air Temperature Sensor (Optional)

data_description.sensor_t_in: Sensor providing real-time room indoor air temperature in °C.
data_description.sensor_t_out: Sensor providing outdoor ambient air temperature in °C.
data_description.sensor_ac_power: Power meter sensor measuring real-time electrical wattage consumed by the AC unit (in Watts).
data_description.sensor_climate: Climate entity to automatically follow active heating/cooling state in Auto mode.
data_description.sensor_solar: Pyranometer sensor measuring global solar radiation in W/m² (optional: if omitted, Clear-Sky model calculates it).
data_description.sensor_weather: Weather provider entity to factor cloud coverage into solar irradiance calculations.
data_description.sensor_window: Binary sensor detecting open/closed window state for natural ventilation airflow calculations.
data_description.sensor_illuminance: Indoor light sensor used to automatically detect when window curtains are drawn during daylight.
data_description.sensor_t_ac_exit: Temperature sensor placed at the indoor unit supply air louver to measure direct AC heat extraction.
data_description.sensor_rh_in: Indoor humidity sensor used for enthalpy, dew point, and condensate moisture calculations.
data_description.sensor_rh_out: Outdoor relative humidity sensor used for psychrometric calculations.
data_description.sensor_wind_speed: Anemometer sensor providing outdoor wind speed for stack and wind pressure ventilation calculations.
data_description.sensor_wind_direction: Wind vane sensor providing compass direction (0-360°) to calculate direct wind pressure on windows.
